text: Halt! Who goes there? [breath] *Nobody* passes without the password.
Fine, fine. Go on through... and keep your blade sheathed.
Welcome, welcome! You look like someone who appreciates a *bargain*.
[whisper 0.9]Between you and me, the dragon's hoard isn't where they say it is.[/whisper]
Rest now. [warm]You did everything you could.[/warm] Did the fever break?
The village of Ashford had not seen rain in forty days. On the forty-first, the stranger arrived.
